1. (Currently Amended) A method for preparing a cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix comprising:
i) removing epidermis of __donor__ allograft skin __to expose dermis__;
ii) removing cells in __the exposed__ dermis __to form an acellular dermal matrix__;
iii) mixing glycerol, and a basic solution selected from a buffer solution and an animal cell culture medium __to form a mixed solution__;
iv) dissolving sucrose in the __mixed__ solution to a final concentration of 20 to 40% by weight to obtain a cryoprotectant;
v) penetrating the cryoprotectant into the __acellular dermal matrix__ [[skin from which epidermis and cells in dermis are removed]]; __and__
vi) freezing the cryoprotectant-penetrated __acellular dermal matrix__ [[skin]] in a controlled rate freezer __to form the cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix__.

2. (Previously presented) The method for preparing a cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix according to claim 1, wherein the mixing ratio of glycerol and the basic solution is 0.5__-__[[~]] 3 : 9 based on weight.

3. (Previously presented) The method for preparing a cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix according to claim 1, wherein the buffer solution is selected from PBS (phosphate buffered saline), TBS (Tris-buffered saline) and citric acid buffer.

4. (Currently Amended) The method for preparing a cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix according to claim 1, wherein the animal cell culture medium is selected from MEM (Minimum Essential Media), DMEM (Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Media), RPMI 1640, IMDM (Iscove's Modified Dulbecco's Media), Defined Keratinocyte-SFM __(without BPE)__[[without BPE)]], Keratinocyte-SFM __(with BPE)__[[(with BPE)]], KnockOut D-MEM, AmnioMAX-II Complete Medium and AmnioMAX-C100 Complete Medium.

5. (Currently Amended) The method for preparing a cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix according to claim 1, wherein the final concentration of sucrose __in the cryoprotectant__ is 30% by weight.

6. (Currently Amended) The method for preparing a cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix according to claim 1, wherein the cryoprotectant is penetrated into the __acellular dermal matrix__ [[separated skin]] in a 4°C low-temperature bath for 6 to 24 hours.

7. (Currently Amended) The method for preparing a cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix according to claim 1, wherein the cryoprotectant-penetrated __acellular dermal matrix__ [[skin]] is frozen in a controlled rate freezer at a freezing rate of -1°C per minute.

8. (Currently Amended) An autograft substitute comprising the cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix which is prepared by the method according to any one of claims 1 to 7__, wherein the cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix comprises a sucrose concentration of 20 to 40% by weight__.
